device: iPhone 16 Plus simulator, iOS 18.5, light appearance, normal text
account: Fictional isolated UI fixture; no personal account or Health data
scenario: Open Profile, Settings, then the equipment-weight editor
Tap Save and hold its HTTP success response locally
Tap Back and verify Settings is visible

before-late-save.png.result: Original Dumbbells editor incorrectly navigates back again to Profile

after-late-save.png.result: Fixed editor stays on Settings after the delayed response; no save alert

candidateNativeChecks: Dumbbells: Save, Back, delayed success; remains on Settings
Plates: Save, Back, delayed success; remains on Settings
Dumbbells: normal Save, delayed success; returns to Settings once
transport: Real app, providers and Expo Router; loopback proxy intercepts equipment PUTs and echoes their captured bodies on release. No equipment PUT reaches the backend. This is navigation verification, not backend persistence verification.
harnessQualification: An initial helper run failed because its HTTP POST omitted a body. The helper was corrected and the complete three-case native flow passed on rerun.

automatedVerification.lint: zero errors; two pre-existing warnings in animated-checkmark.tsx and hero-neon-line.tsx

limits: Account changes, unmount, blur/refocus, stale failures, repeated taps and both themes are covered by renderer tests with explicit native/navigation mocks. Native captures are light/normal-text only. No new physical-device, Android or VoiceOver certification; no visual redesign.
